runtimes.name: Core Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns browser runtime primitives, company boundary helpers, correlation and shared lifecycle contracts.

runtimes.name: Interaction Engine
runtimes.purpose: Owns understanding, conversation, journeys, wizards and PresentationIntent; never grants execution authority.

runtimes.name: Decision Engine
runtimes.purpose: Owns evidence-backed option evaluation, prediction, ranking and selected recommendations; never directly executes browser effects.

runtimes.name: Prime Mission Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns durable objectives, missions, checkpoints and bounded delegation; authority remains external.

runtimes.name: Authority Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns local governance/autonomy/T0GM proof evaluation boundaries; identity is not authority.

runtimes.name: Safety Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns risk, assurance, shield and trust-proof evaluation boundaries; may constrain or block effects.

runtimes.name: Execution Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns command/capability dispatch envelopes and provider receipts; providers perform effects only after authority gates.

runtimes.name: Knowledge Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns local knowledge provenance, freshness and retrieval contracts; private records remain company scoped.

runtimes.name: Outcome Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns signal, rewind, outcome and learning-event contracts; does not rewrite historical evidence.

runtimes.name: Interface Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns declarative presentation composition and contributions; never owns business meaning or action authority.

runtimes.name: Visual Runtime
runtimes.purpose: Owns motion, transitions, visual treatments, assets and accessibility degradation; never changes business meaning.
